item.title: MC1526697: Dynamics 365 apps and Dataverse – Information about the 2026 time zone changes in Canada
item.description: What and why Dynamics 365 apps and Dataverse are being updated to add the new Canadian time zone definitions in support of the 2026 time zone changes in Manitoba, Alberta, and British Columbia. This is a general awareness message to support the changes and complements MC1510951 — Windows updates are available for 2026 time zone changes in Canada . Rollout schedule The Dataverse configuration update is being deployed through the regular release train and is scheduled to reach the Canada region by...

item.title: RM410396: Microsoft Viva: Import HRIS data in Viva Glint from Microsoft Admin Center
item.description: Customers will be able to use various connectors to HRIS tools to import HRIS data into Viva Glint from Microsoft Admin Center.

item.title: RM420335: Microsoft Edge: Rewrite by Copilot in Edge is being upgraded to include enterprise data protection compliance standards
item.description: Rewrite by Copilot in Edge, which lets users edit typed text for tone, format, and length within an open page in Microsoft Edge, is being updated to include enterprise data protection for commercial customers. Once Rewrite is available, users signed in with a Microsoft Entra ID will have enterprise data protection when using the feature in Microsoft Edge. Updated March 20, 2026: We have paused release of this feature temporarily and will announce new release timelines soon. We apologize for any...

item.title: RM545896: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Structured Document Generation with Forms
item.description: Structured Document Generation with Forms enables organizations to create, manage, and generate standardized documents at scale with built-in governance and compliance in SharePoint. Business process owners can centrally build and maintain form-driven templates -- such as contracts, agreements, proposals, and HR documents -- ensuring content stays accurate and up to date. Users can then generate the right document every time by just filling out the form, without manual formatting, versioning iss...

item.title: RM558343: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management– Hard delete capability for OneDrive and SharePoint through secure priority cleanup workflows
item.description: Data Lifecycle Management allows compliance admins to retain, review and delete content in M365 workloads. Deletion of content to adhere to compliance requirements, admins can set up Retention policies or labels. To help prevent inadvertent data loss, M365 retention labels policies and M365 retention policies do not hard delete content immediately and keeps the data in Recycle Bins for 93 days for ODSP. Hard delete itself is a very costly process as it opens Microsoft to heavy legal implications...

item.title: RM558595: Microsoft 365: Companion apps - Copilot prompts in the Files app now available for Copilot Chat users
item.description: The Files companion app, part of the Microsoft 365 companion apps suite on the Windows taskbar, now surfaces AI-powered Copilot file prompts for Copilot Chat users. Previously available only to Microsoft 365 Copilot licensees, this update extends contextual file prompts to Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat users, enabling them to discover and interact with relevant files through intelligent suggestions. Users can find their most relevant files faster and take action on them directly from the Files app....

item.title: RM562220: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Supercharge your workflows with computer use
item.description: Add resilient, AI-powered UI automation directly into your workflows with computer use tools. Makers can build reusable, goal-oriented automations that adapt dynamically to website or app changes, while admins maintain governance through access controls, hosted browser management, and environment-level permissions. Update: This roadmap item is no longer accurate and will be removed from the roadmap. We apologize for any inconvenience.

item.title: RM562353: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Session and Response Sharing in M365 Copilot
item.description: Session and Response Sharing let Microsoft 365 Copilot users share Copilot chat content through a link. Session Sharing shares a full chat session, while Response Sharing shares a single Copilot response. The shared content opens as a read-only view, and recipients can continue from it in their own Copilot chat. This gives Copilot users an easier and more controlled way to share useful Copilot outputs with coworkers instead of copying and pasting. It helps teams reuse work, share context, and co...

item.title: RM562648: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Identifiable Export metrics in the Copilot Dashboard
item.description: This enables users to export Identifiable row-level Copilot metrics from the Copilot Dashboard for reporting and deeper analysis. This capability can be tuned On by Admins in a tenant.

item.title: RM566317: Microsoft Viva: Create and customize PBI reports
item.description: We are introducing a new feature for leaders and analysts of Viva Insights, where they can view a Power BI report, and edit time range, filters, attributes and change visuals as per their organizations' needs. They can then save the report for viewing later.

item.title: RM566998: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Invoke agents as workflow steps with the agent node
item.description: The agent node lets you embed reasoning directly into your workflow. This means fewer manual handoffs, faster processing times, and workflows that can handle nuanced decisions without additional development effort, helping teams automate more of their end-to-end processes and reduce operational overhead.

item.title: RM567318: Outlook: Reply with a Template in Rules
item.description: You can now create a rule that automatically replies to incoming messages with a template you've set up. Set the conditions you care about and pick the template, and Outlook handles the response for you. It's a simple way to send consistent replies without typing the same thing over and over. #newoutlookforwindows

item.title: RM569423: Microsoft Teams: Hide Organizer name in Calendar View on Teams Panels
item.description: Admins can now choose whether the organizer name will show up in the Calendar View on Teams panels. Admins can toggle the "Show organizer name" setting ON or OFF in the Pro Management portal or on the panel device. Based on the selection, the organizer name will or will not be shown in the calendar view on the panel device. Available with Teams Rooms Pro and Teams Shared Space licenses.

item.title: RM569476: Planner: Conditional Coloring
item.description: Conditional Coloring highlight tasks based on selected criteria, making priorities, status, and important task details easier to spot.

item.title: RM569733: Planner: Capacity view
item.description: Capacity view shows a timeline of who's working on what, so you can see how work is distributed across your team and spot overload or open capacity at a glance.

item.title: RM569933: Planner: Task History
item.description: Task History helps keep teams up to date on changes made to a task. View recent activity to see what changed, when it changed, and track progress over time.

item.title: RM571198: PowerPoint: Clear view-only messaging
item.description: When you open a presentation you don't have permission to edit, PowerPoint now shows a clear "Viewing Only" message bar. It explains that the file is view-only, shows who created it, and tells you to contact the owner if you need more access.

item.title: RM576199: Microsoft Teams: Expanded Markdown support in Microsoft Teams
item.description: Microsoft Teams is expanding Markdown support in the compose box, giving you more ways to structure and format messages using familiar Markdown syntax. Create richer, more readable messages while staying in the Markdown authoring experience.

item.title: RM576270: Outlook: Multiple Intune Accounts in Outlook for Android
item.description: Multiple MAM (Mobile Application Management) Intune Accounts will now be supported in Outlook for Android. Only one MDM (Mobile Device Management) account will be supported at a time per device.

item.title: RM576605: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Boost contact center efficiency with real-time streaming analytics
item.description: Real-time streaming analytics is built into the new supervisor application. An advanced streaming engine keeps metrics up to date with near-instant updates, allowing supervisors to view the latest data without refreshing the dashboard.

item.title: RM576708: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): SharePoint Site Builder
item.description: This feature enables users to easily create new SharePoint sites with Copilot. Users can review and confirm a clear site plan before Copilot builds the site.

item.title: RM577174: Microsoft Teams: Workflow to automatically add tag members to relevant channels
item.description: Associate channels with a tag so members are automatically added to those channels when they join the tag. This helps teams keep channel membership in sync with evolving groups, reduces manual management, and ensures members have access to the conversations and content most relevant to their role.

item.title: RM577177: Excel: Edit with Copilot in Excel on iPhone
item.description: Edit with Copilot makes it easier to edit and transform your Excel workbooks on your phone using natural language. Copilot can continue working on your task even when you move away from the app, so you can come back when the work is ready. Chat mode also remains available when you want to ask questions and get insights without making changes to your workbook.

item.title: RM577404: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Support trade counter sales in POS
item.description: Trade Counter POS is a collection of capabilities for Dynamics 365 Commerce Point of Sale. Businesses can adopt the capabilities individually to support their trade counter operations rather than enable a single, all-or-nothing experience.

item.title: RM577743: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): App Blocks
item.description: App Blocks enables M365 Copilot Chat users to turn their requests and data into rich, interactive experiences directly within the conversation, including calculators, dashboards, forms, planners, visualizations, simulations, comparison tools, and other interactive apps. It helps users move beyond static responses to explore data, adjust inputs, visualize outcomes, and simulate workflows in place, while supporting grounded scenarios where current information can be retrieved and then rendered int...

item.title: RM577745: Excel: Get and transform data with Copilot in Excel
item.description: Get your data ready, just by asking. Describe the data you need and how you want it prepared, and the new get data skill handles the rest. It can connect and transform your data, then load the results into your workbook using Power Query, giving you a query you can inspect, edit, and refresh without having to build it yourself. Depending on the data source, authentication may be required.

item.title: RM577865: Dynamics 365 Finance: Optimized Customer data entities
item.description: Dynamics 365 Finance introduces a set of optimized customer data entities that provide more focused options for integrating customer information. Instead of relying on a single broad customer entity, organizations can work with purpose-specific entities for core customer information, extended customer attributes, postal addresses, electronic contact information, and customer associations.

item.title: RM577866: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Configure actions on task grid
item.description: This feature extends Task Grid View Templates so administrators can configure both task columns and the visibility of supported task-grid actions in one place. Administrators can show or hide individual actions across task-grid views, the toolbar, row-level controls, and the task context menu.

item.title: RM577890: Dynamics 365 Sustainability: Restate previously calculated emissions
item.description: Organizations can recalculate previously calculated emissions using a new restatement capability in Dynamics 365 Sustainability. Users can create a new calculation result while preserving the original result, helping maintain traceability between the original and restated emissions.

item.title: RM577891: Dynamics 365 Finance: Expand localization in LATAM countries for Argentina
item.description: With the release of Argentina, we are finalizing the LATAM expansion. Out-of-the-box localization is now available for 14 countries in the region through the cross-LATAM localization framework, in addition to Brazil and Mexico.

item.title: RM577897: Power Pages: First Class Support for Connector APIs in Power Pages
item.description: Native connectors support through Power Pages will allow organizations to securely connect their websites/portals directly to enterprise systems such as SQL, SAP, and Oracle, without building or maintaining custom integration layers.

item.title: MC1526679: Microsoft Teams Default meeting template
item.description: Default meeting templates let IT admins set organization-wide meeting options for Teams meetings scheduled via Outlook or Teams calendar, ensuring consistency and protection. Rolling out worldwide in November 2026, only Teams Premium licensed organizers can use them. Admins create and assign templates; some meeting types are excluded.

item.title: MC1526676: Microsoft 365 admin center: Manage authoritative sources for Microsoft 365 Copilot Search
item.description: Admins with Global admin or reader roles can manage up to 100 authoritative SharePoint Online sites in Microsoft 365 Copilot Search via the admin center, enhancing search relevance. This AI-driven feature rolls out worldwide in late September 2026 and includes centralized governance and bulk import/export capabilities.

item.title: MC1526668: Change Optics Report
item.description: The Change Optics report for Exchange Online is now generally available worldwide, helping admins identify email traffic affected by upcoming service changes. Accessible in the Exchange Admin Center, it highlights onmicrosoft.com external traffic and Direct Send traffic to aid investigation and remediation. No action required.

item.title: MC1441784: Microsoft Copilot for Outlook: New Copilot entry point in Classic Outlook
item.description: Microsoft is updating the Copilot entry point in Classic Outlook to a new location next to the ribbon, offering easier access and AI-powered contextual recommendations. The rollout begins mid-November 2026 worldwide, with no changes to licensing or admin settings. No action is required, but user communication is recommended.

item.title: MC1472028: Outlook: Change the organizer of meetings
item.description: Microsoft is enabling Outlook users to transfer meeting organizer roles within their organization, improving meeting continuity during role changes or leave. The rollout begins November 2026 for non-online meetings, with phased support for Teams meetings and artifacts. The feature requires acceptance by the new organizer and preserves meeting content.

item.title: MC1526661: Microsoft 365 Apps: Cloud Update - Export Improvements
item.description: Microsoft 365 Apps Cloud Update will enhance export capabilities in Inventory and Cloud Update views, adding more device and update details, filtered exports, and new columns like Cloud Update Status. Rollout starts November 2026. No action or compliance changes are needed.

item.title: MC1526652: AI Builder credits retirement: Prepare to use Copilot Credits
item.description: Microsoft is retiring AI Builder credits by November 1, 2026, replacing them with Copilot Credits. Organizations must plan and purchase Copilot Credits before AI Builder credits expire to avoid service interruptions. AI Builder features continue, but licensing and credit management require admin action.

item.title: MC1526651: Microsoft Teams: Malicious QR code detection in messages
item.description: Microsoft Teams will detect malicious QR codes in messages, providing warnings for phishing or fraud threats starting November 2026. This applies to chats and channels, with QR code blurring for external senders. The feature is enabled by default via Malicious URL protection, requiring no admin action.

item.title: MC1492959: Audio Overview Updates
item.description: Microsoft is enhancing Audio Overview with topic-based episodes for easier navigation, support for more content types (OneNote, Loop, emails, Teams chats/meetings, .txt files), and sensitivity label inheritance when saving to OneDrive. The update rolls out globally from early to late November 2026 with no admin action needed.

item.title: MC1474106: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: New MessageContents table in Advanced Hunting for Microsoft Teams messages
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 introduces a new MessageContents table in Advanced Hunting for Teams messages, enabling authorized security analysts to query message snippets and metadata for threat investigations. Rollout is from late September to mid-November 2026. Access requires specific permissions and may impact security procedures.

item.title: MC1470410: Microsoft Teams: QR code protection for messages from external users
item.description: Microsoft Teams will blur QR code images from external users by default starting mid-October 2026 to reduce phishing risks. Users can reveal images if trusted. No admin action is needed, but admins should inform users and update related guidance. The feature applies across all Teams platforms automatically.

item.title: MC1450133: Microsoft Entra: Users can register a passkey or passwordless sign-in as their first multifactor authentication method
item.description: Microsoft Entra will allow users to register passkeys or passwordless sign-in as their first multifactor authentication method, removing the prior requirement to set up alternate MFA methods first. The phased rollout begins November 2026, aiming to simplify strong authentication adoption and reduce registration friction.

item.title: MC1526468: Update to MC1510951: Canada 2026 time zone changes — Microsoft 365 impact and required admin actions
item.description: On November 1, 2026, certain Canadian regions will not change clocks, affecting Microsoft 365 scheduling. Admins must update Windows, Outlook time zones, review meetings, update Teams Rooms, and keep apps current. Testing and support case submission with #Canada Time-Zone are advised.

item.title: MC1473155: Microsoft Purview: permissions audit log improvements
item.description: Microsoft Purview is enhancing audit logging for role-based access control, adding two new audit operations to improve transparency and troubleshooting of access checks. This update, rolling out worldwide from late September to October 2026, requires no action and provides administrators better visibility into access evaluations.

item.title: MC1505607: Outlook: Reply With a Template in Rules
item.description: New Outlook for Windows and Outlook on the web will let users create inbox rules to auto-reply with saved templates, automating repetitive responses. Rollout starts mid-October 2026 (Targeted Release) and completes by late December 2026 (General Availability). No admin action is required before rollout.

item.title: MC1261587: Microsoft Purview | Data Lifecycle Management - Hard delete OneDrive and SharePoint files with priority cleanup workflow
item.description: Microsoft Purview introduces a priority cleanup workflow allowing admins to hard delete specific OneDrive and SharePoint content, even under retention or holds, with required eDiscovery approval. Rolling out mid-August 2026, it enhances data risk management and compliance without affecting user workflows unless configured by admins.

item.title: MC1220762: Retirement notice: MDE and XDR Advanced Hunting APIs retiring; migrate to Microsoft Graph Security API
item.description: Microsoft is retiring the Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and Defender XDR Advanced Hunting APIs by February 1, 2027. Organizations must manually migrate workflows to the Microsoft Graph Security API by January 31, 2027, to ensure continued functionality and improved security integration.

item.title: MC1483527: Dynamics 365 and Power Platform– Information about storage validation for Dataverse-only tenants
item.description: Beginning November 9, 2026, we are introducing staged storage validation for supported Dynamics 365 applications. The change gives administrators clearer visibility into storage use, advance notice of potential restrictions, and several ways to remain within capacity, including removing unneeded data, adding capacity, or enabling pay-as-you-go for sandbox environments. If no corrective action is initiated after repeated notifications, when a tenant exceeds its entitled Database, File, or Log cap...

item.title: MC1523090: Microsoft Teams: Initiate side conversations within the meeting chat window
item.description: Microsoft Teams will allow users to start or continue private side conversations within the meeting chat window, preserving chat history. This feature rolls out worldwide in January 2027, requires no admin action, and users can disable the side-chat tab if desired. No compliance issues identified.

item.title: RM576279: Power Apps: Model-driven apps - Use row summaries in US Government clouds
item.description: Row summaries are expanding to supported US Government clouds, giving users in regulated environments access to AI-generated insights that help them understand model-driven app records at a glance. This release brings the row summary experience available to commercial customers to supported government environments while meeting their applicable compliance and data-boundary requirements.

item.title: RM576607: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Unified routing - Use overflow actions to protect customer experience for direct inward calls
item.description: Overflow for direct inward dialing leverages conversation orchestration to detect key direct inward dialing-related events—such as the representative being busy, offline, rejecting the call, or failing to answer—and apply administrator-defined fallback actions.

item.title: RM577796: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Workforce engagement management - Enforce governance policies on email attachments
item.description: This feature extends governance capabilities to evaluate email attachments, closing a critical gap where sensitive or non-compliant information may exist outside the email body.

item.title: RM577798: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Workforce engagement management - Manage policy strictness to enforce governance policies
item.description: This feature introduces policy strictness control, enabling organizations to define how rigorously each governance policy evaluates and flags potential violations in outgoing emails. Governance policies serve as real-time guardrails, ensuring communications adhere to business, legal, and compliance standards before they are sent to customers.

item.title: MC1523087: Microsoft Teams Mobile: Ask Copilot from Search
item.description: Microsoft Teams mobile will let users ask Copilot directly from the search box on iOS and Android, with suggestions appearing after typing two words and an Ask Copilot button on search results. This feature rolls out worldwide from mid to late November 2026, requiring no admin action.

item.title: MC1523086: Alternate text parameter for ODSP attached images in Teams
item.description: Microsoft Teams will support adding alt text to OneDrive/SharePoint-hosted images shared in chats, enhancing accessibility with screen reader descriptions. This feature rolls out worldwide from early to mid-December 2026, requires no admin action, and allows users to add or edit alt text without changing the original image files.

item.title: MC1523085: Viva Insights: GitHub Copilot metrics will be on by default, and the public preview opt-in setting is being retired
item.description: GitHub Copilot metrics will be enabled by default in the Viva Insights Consumption dashboard starting mid-November 2026, retiring the public preview opt-in setting. Eligible tenants will see these metrics automatically, with existing access controls remaining. No admin action is required, but reviewing access and updating documentation is recommended.

item.title: MC1523084: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Move email messages to quarantine with a new remediation action
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 Plan 2 introduces a new "Move to Quarantine" remediation action allowing admins to move suspicious emails from user mailboxes to Defender quarantine for safer investigation and management. It rolls out worldwide from November to December 2026, requiring no user action but recommended policy reviews and training updates.

item.title: MC1523077: Teams admin center - Intelligent insights for meeting quality
item.description: AI-powered meeting quality insights in Teams admin center provide proactive detection of issues by analyzing historical data, highlighting hotspots, root causes, and affected users with recommended actions. Rolling out worldwide and GCC from mid-November 2026. No configuration needed; accessible to designated Teams admins.

item.title: MC1523076: Microsoft Teams: Loop meeting notes stored in the meeting organizer's OneDrive
item.description: Non-channel Microsoft Teams meeting notes, including Loop and Facilitator notes, will be stored in the meeting organizer’s OneDrive for Business starting mid-November 2026. This ensures consistent ownership without changing the collaboration experience. No configuration is needed, but update governance processes accordingly. Channel meeting notes storage remains unchanged.

item.title: MC1482800: Teams Phone Agent is rolling out to general availability on Sept 30, 2026
item.description: Teams Phone Agent, an AI-powered calling solution for Microsoft Teams, will be generally available worldwide starting late September 2026. Usage-based billing with Copilot Credits requires admins to configure spending policies and security groups in the Microsoft 365 admin center to avoid default auto attendant settings.

item.title: RM578077: Dynamics 365 Sales: Lead management - Personalize outreach emails generated by Sales Qualification Agent
item.description: Define outreach scenario/goal in natural language.

item.title: RM578075: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Workforce engagement management - Enable enhanced screen recording controls for admins
item.description: The enhanced screen recording capability offers greater flexibility and control, enabling organizations to manage recording behavior with more precision. Key enhancements include:

item.title: RM578076: Dynamics 365 Sales: Lead management - Deploy multiple Sales Qualification Agents in a single environment
item.description: Segment-specific qualification: Each agent operates with its own ideal customer profile, knowledge sources, templates, and consent settings, ensuring qualification conversations reflect the nuances of each product, region, or team.

item.title: RM578074: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Workforce engagement management - Enable enhanced screen recording controls for admins
item.description: The enhanced screen recording capability offers greater flexibility and control, enabling organizations to manage recording behavior with more precision. Key enhancements include:

item.title: RM578072: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys: Elevate customer experiences - Boost productivity with flexible views and search in segments
item.description: Customize your view: choose a Contact or Lead view from the new view picker to define which columns appear in the segment members table.

item.title: RM578073: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Workforce engagement management - Manage overnight shifts as a single continuous schedule
item.description: Supervisors can now create and manage overnight shifts that span across midnight while maintaining a single continuous shift experience. Shift plans support start and end times that extend into the next day, allowing organizations to accurately model overnight operations such as contact centers, support teams, healthcare services, and other 24x7 environments.

item.title: RM578071: Power Pages: Administration and governance - Configure site analytics and server logging
item.description: Gain insights into your Power Pages site with integrated telemetry and analytics. Use Application Insights to monitor page views, form interactions, session details, and client-side analytics. Detect server-side errors, performance issues, and access logs to resolve problems and optimize your site.

item.title: RM578070: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Workforce engagement management - Modify and override submitted evaluations
item.description: This feature enables Quality Managers to edit and override evaluation results even after they are marked as completed or expired. While completed evaluations remain read-only by default to preserve integrity, supervisors can initiate an Edit action when discrepancies are identified, such as incorrect AI predictions or errors in manual assessments.

item.title: RM578069: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: IVR capabilities - Equip voice agents with custom voice
item.description: Secure a voice talent that will represent the voice of your brand. After obtaining explicit consent, gaining Limited Access approval through Microsoft's Responsible AI practices, and building a custom voice model, it's time to integrate with Dynamics 365 Contact Center.

item.title: RM578068: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Envision and design AI agents in Business Central
item.description: AI agents in Business Central

item.title: RM578067: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Workforce engagement management - Enforce governance policy
item.description: Create and enforce policies that prevent risky or noncompliant customer communications.

item.title: RM578066: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Digital commerce - Streamline multioutlet access for B2B web storefronts
item.description: The multioutlet B2B web storefront introduces a unified sign-in system that allows buyers to access all their associated organizations and outlets using a single account. The storefront UI is updated to display an organization selector during sign-in and provides outlet-specific navigation and catalog views. Buyers can place, track, and manage orders for multiple outlets within a single session, with real-time visibility into order status, inventory, and account information.

item.title: RM578065: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Run multiple Sales Order Agents per company with smarter item matching, relevance filtering, and streamlined setup
item.description: You can now configure and run multiple Sales Order Agent instances in a single company. Each instance operates independently with its own mailbox, folder settings, email signature, and processing rules.

item.title: RM578064: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Copilot and AI innovation - Resolve customer emails autonomously with AI
item.description: Autonomous email resolution delivers end-to-end handling of customer emails without manual intervention or default case creation. When an email arrives, the system analyzes the request, identifies the underlying intent, and determines whether the information and actions needed to resolve it are available.

item.title: RM578063: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management: Planning - Protect confirmed CTP dates with Planning Optimization
item.description: Planning Optimization is the new high-performance planning engine for Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management. With this feature, Planning Optimization now protects material and capacity allocated to sales order lines with delivery dates confirmed through capable to promise (CTP). You prevent reallocation of resources to newer orders, so your confirmed delivery dates stay reliable, and customer commitments are honored.

item.title: RM578062: Power Pages: Administration and governance - Manage external authentication providers with granular controls
item.description: Power Pages now lets you manage external authentication providers with environment-level governance controls and optional site-level exceptions. You can centrally enforce which identity providers (IDPs) are allowed across all sites in an environment, while still enabling site-specific flexibility when needed. Makers will only see and select from the approved IDPs when setting up authentication, ensuring consistent governance and alignment with enterprise security policies.

item.title: RM578061: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Omnichannel commerce - Add support for multiple outlet B2B ordering via CSU
item.description: Available for B2B scenarios in Dynamics 365 Commerce (including headless Commerce), this feature enables retailers to configure unified sign-in in Commerce headquarters and integrate third‑party storefronts using CSU APIs. The organization selector and related capabilities are exposed via CSU endpoints so that third-party sites can consume identities, organizational context, and ordering workflows without relying on native UI components.

item.title: RM396575: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Loss Prevention - Decoupling of Policy tips and Email notifications while configuring rules on Data Loss Prevention for Sharepoint and Onedriv
item.description: As of today, whenever the user wants to enable email notifications the policy tips also need to be enabled and vice versa, but with this decoupling the admin can configure the following: 1) None of policy tips or email notification 2) Only policy tips 3) Only Email Notifications 4) Both Email Notifications and Policy tips

item.title: RM488301: Microsoft Teams: Speaker attribution now “On” by default in BYOD rooms with enhanced admin controls
item.description: New PowerShell setting (SpeakerAttributionBYOD in csTeamsAIPolicy), enabled by default, gives IT admins more control over speaker attribution in BYOD (bring your own device) meeting rooms. This enhances the experience for users by enabling clear speaker labels and richer in-meeting and post-meeting insights with Microsoft 365 Copilot. Users just enroll profiles via Teams Settings to be recognized.

item.title: RM559482: Microsoft Viva: Recent feed in Viva Engage
item.description: Introducing a new “Recent” feed in Home to give users a more predictable view of followed and priority communications, while preserving the existing personalized “For you” experience.

item.title: RM562351: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Get actionable suggestions from Copilot in your Copilot Page
item.description: Request feedback from Copilot on your Page by selecting "Suggested edits" in the Copilot Shortcuts menu. Copilot will analyze the content on your page and provide actionable suggestions about what you can change to improve clarity and quality of your written content. You can then apply suggestions directly to the page. Updated October 23, 2026: We have decided not to move forward with this change at this time. We apologize for any inconvenience.

item.title: RM566316: OneDrive: Refreshed file browsing and filtering experience in OneDrive Web
item.description: OneDrive is making it easier to find and work with files across Microsoft 365. We're refreshing the filtering experience across OneDrive Web, updating existing filters in views like Home, Shared, People, Meetings, and Favorites to support multiple filters at once, and bringing those same filtering capabilities to folder-based experiences such as My files and shared folders. Users can also filter content by file type using both filter pills and the filter pane.

item.title: RM568368: Outlook: Copilot Chat pop-out for Outlook for Mac and iPad
item.description: Copilot Chat remains accessible within an Outlook app window but now can also be popped out to float over the main Outlook app window. Popping out Copilot Chat allows people to switch contexts or have more space for what they are working on in Outlook and control the space and form that Copilot Chat takes on screen. When you open Copilot chat and click the pop-out button, Copilot will open separately over the main Outlook window.

item.title: RM569210: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): CSV and TSV references in Copilot Notebooks
item.description: Copilot Notebooks now supports CSV and TSV files as knowledge sources, allowing users to bring structured lists and tables directly into their projects alongside traditional documents. This additional context helps Copilot generate more relevant presentations, reports, and briefs.

item.title: RM569211: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): JPG and PNG references in Copilot Notebooks
item.description: Copilot Notebooks now supports JPG and PNG files as knowledge sources, allowing users to bring images directly into their projects alongside traditional documents. Copilot can use the content within these images, including text, charts, diagrams, and other visuals, as grounding context to help generate more relevant presentations, reports, and briefs.

item.title: RM576275: Planner: Custom Views for plans
item.description: Custom views lets users save a custom view of a plan and return to it later without re-applying filters, sorting, grouping, and other view customizations. A team can reuse saved views for triage, prioritization, work tracking, and more.

item.title: RM576281: Power Apps: Form fill assistance using speech as input in model-driven apps
item.description: We’re expanding form fill assistance in Power Apps to use speech as a source, providing users a more natural way to fill forms. Users select the microphone icon, record their content, and the transcript is used as a source for the form entry. Recordings are transient and not saved.

item.title: RM576283: Power Apps: Use Power Platform connectors in generative pages
item.description: Makers can bring data from Power Platform connectors into generative pages. After creating and authenticating a connection and adding a connection reference to the environment, you select the connector data and describe how the generated page should use it. Connector data can be incorporated while working in the Maker Studio generative page designer or through the generative pages AI plugin.

item.title: RM576285: Power Apps: Expand model access and Maker Studio availability for generative pages via GitHub

item.description: Microsoft Purview Communication Compliance will enhance policy alert customization, allowing admins to set alert frequency and recipients per policy. item.title: MC1478965: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Retention for Copilot Memory
item.description: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management now supports retention of Microsoft 365 Copilot memory items, preserving historical versions for compliance and investigations. item.description: Azure PST Import enables Microsoft 365 admins to import PST files from Azure Blob Storage into Exchange Online mailboxes using PowerShell. item.title: MC1281505: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management- Azure PST Import
item.description: Azure PST Import enables Microsoft 365 admins to import PST files from Azure Blob Storage into Exchange Online mailboxes using PowerShell. item.description: Microsoft Purview is introducing a public preview of Adaptive protection integration with Data Lifecycle Management, automatically retaining deleted content from elevated risk users for 120 days. item.title: MC1520901: Insights Agent V2 Frontier
item.description: Insights Agent V2 is now available in Frontier, providing M365 admins tenant-level visibility into agent adoption and control over user feedback sharing. Feedback sharing is off by default and can be enabled in the Microsoft 365 admin center. No compliance issues identified. Public preview rollout is complete.

item.title: MC1519861: Outlook: Copilot Prioritize feature will be retired
item.description: The Copilot Prioritize feature in Outlook will be retired starting October 26, 2026, with removal completed by March 2027. It will be removed from all Outlook clients without requiring opt-in. No admin action is needed, but users should be notified and support materials updated accordingly.

item.title: MC1480870: New SharePoint Mobile Experience on iOS and Android
item.description: The SharePoint mobile app for iOS and Android will roll out a redesigned home with a personalized Discover experience by late October to November 2026. It features improved site browsing, file previews, refreshed news, search, dark mode, and better performance, with no admin action required.

item.title: MC1309743: Viva Engage: Email updates for users without a routable mailbox
item.description: Starting mid-October 2026, Viva Engage will stop sending email notifications to users without valid mailboxes or routable email destinations, reducing email system load and improving delivery. Users with supported mailboxes and Teams notifications remain unaffected. No action is required, but review mailbox configurations and update support accordingly.

item.title: MC1509787: Microsoft Teams: Third-party synthetic audio and video detection in meetings
item.description: Microsoft Teams will support certified third-party synthetic audio and video detection in meetings starting mid-November 2026. Organizations can integrate these solutions to enhance security against AI-generated media threats. Admins must deploy provider apps, grant permissions, and configure meeting policies. Detection is performed by third parties, with Microsoft Teams enabling integration.

item.title: MC1458484: Filter Messages by Events on Outlook Mobile
item.description: Outlook Mobile will add an "Events" filter to quickly find calendar invitations and event-related messages. Rolling out worldwide and in GCC environments from late August to late September 2026. No admin action needed; users can better manage meeting invites and RSVPs.

item.title: MC1519866: Microsoft Teams: Phishing detection for messaging
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce AI-powered, context-aware phishing detection starting November 2026, focusing on external first-contact chats and additional protection for mobile users in China. It identifies suspicious behavior without retaining message content, requires no admin action, and aims solely for security protection.

item.title: MC1519860: Intelligent Call Delegation in Teams
item.description: Intelligent Call Delegation in Teams uses AI to answer calls, gather context, and schedule follow-ups via Microsoft Bookings, helping users focus on important conversations. Rolling out from November 2026 (preview) to January 2027 (general availability), it requires appropriate licensing and admin configuration. No compliance issues identified.

item.title: MC1519857: Microsoft Teams: Chat for organizers and presenters in structured meetings and webinars on Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: Teams Rooms on Android with Teams Rooms Pro license will gain access to a private presenter chat in green room-enabled meetings/events when joined as organizers. This backstage chat appears as "Event group" or "Planning group." Rollout starts August 2025 (preview) and completes November 2026 (general availability). No admin action needed.

item.title: MC1519855: Microsoft Entra: Choose your own telephony provider for SMS and voice authentication
item.description: Starting October 30, 2026, Microsoft Entra ID allows organizations to choose a supported third-party telephony provider for SMS and voice authentication via Microsoft Security Store. Microsoft-provided SMS/voice authentication retires by February 1, 2027, except for some users until July 1, 2027. Organizations manage provider relationships directly.

item.title: MC1519846: Microsoft 365 apps: Updated Brand Kit management experience
item.description: Microsoft 365 apps updated the Brand Kit management experience to simplify setup, streamline asset management, and improve workflows for Brand Managers. The update is available worldwide with no action required, helping organizations efficiently maintain on-brand content and scale creation using Copilot.

item.title: MC1519843: New Outlook for Windows: All Accounts view brings email into a single inbox view
item.description: The new Outlook for Windows introduces an All Accounts view, a unified inbox showing emails from multiple accounts separately without merging. It supports AI-assisted workflows and search, rolling out globally by late October 2026. No admin action is needed now; controls will be available later.

item.title: MC1519842: Microsoft OneNote: JPG and PNG references in Copilot Notebooks
item.description: Microsoft OneNote now supports using JPG and PNG images as knowledge sources in Copilot Notebooks, enabling Copilot to extract and use visual content for generating outputs. The feature is globally available since October 2026, requires no admin action, and affects users with Copilot Notebook access.

item.title: MC1519841: Microsoft OneNote: CSV and TSV references in Copilot Notebooks
item.description: Microsoft OneNote now supports using CSV and TSV files as knowledge sources in Copilot Notebooks, enhancing content generation with structured data. The feature is globally available since mid-October 2026, requires no user action, and automatically enables for tenants with existing CSV/TSV Copilot permissions.

item.description: Deliver consistent scheduling outcomes across Dynamics 365 Project Operations and Field Service, regardless of where scheduling begins. item.description: Expense Agent can automatically create expense reports based on identified business trips. You just need to configure the feature on the Expense Agent Setup page. item.description: This feature introduces support for a simple interim approval scenario for expense reports. Interim approver must review expense reports to confirm whether they're complete and compliant before final approver.

item.description: The Expense Manager Role Center is updated to provide a more focused and efficient experience for managing vendor and expense-related activities. item.description: The Batch Total field on the Payment Journal page enhances payment processing by enabling you to work with and review a cumulative total for a payment journal batch. item.description: Admins and developers can monitor published generative pages with Application Insights. item.description: Makers can have a generative page call a Dataverse custom API to run server-side business logic, such as approving an order, recalculating a price, or validating a transaction. item.title: RM576296: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Restrict task assignments to project team members
item.description: This feature strengthens assignment governance by limiting the resources displayed in the Assigned to column to members of the current project team. item.description: Viva Glint admins can now customize the Microsoft Teams notifications sent for surveys. item.description: Newly created Microsoft Viva Engage communities will have Microsoft 365 group settings enabled by default, subscribing members to community emails and calendar invites. item.description: Microsoft Clipchamp will add an admin policy control to manage user access to the AI-powered "Create a video" feature, rolling out worldwide from late November to early December 2026. item.title: MC1518033: Microsoft Teams: Onboarding workflow for new team members
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce an onboarding workflow to automatically connect new members to relevant channels, improving engagement and onboarding speed. item.description: In product monitoring logs to track all activities related to backup policy configuration & restore related tasks. This will help admins with troubleshooting, monitoring, reporting and auditing capabilities.

item.title: RM560538: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Export metrics from Agent Dashboard
item.description: Users can export de-identified, row-level agent metrics and attributes from the Agent Dashboard. Exported data provides detailed insights into agent usage and user-level agent interactions across the organization, with personal identifiers removed.

item.title: RM560820: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Increase in expansion limit for auto expanding archive beyond 1.5TB
item.description: Previously, auto expanding archive mailbox expansion was supported only up to 1.5 TB, after which mailboxes would become inoperative. This capability to expand archive beyond 1.5 TB will be available to customers with eligible E5 licenses.

item.title: RM568790: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Review PDFs using the Copilot context menu on OneDrive iOS
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot makes PDF reviews faster and easier on mobile. Select text in any PDF in OneDrive iOS and tap Ask Copilot to explain, summarize, translate, or ask a custom question about the selection — the same in-context Copilot experience already generally available on desktop, now on OneDrive iOS. item.title: RM568936: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator Can Join Channel Meetings
item.description: Facilitator can now join meetings set up in Teams channels. Facilitator helps participants run more effective meetings through the ability to take live notes, manage the agenda, answer questions, and capture tasks.

item.title: RM570157: Microsoft Viva: Campaigns Hub in Engage and Engage in Teams mobile
item.description: The Campaigns Hub in Viva Engage provides a centralized mobile destination where employees can discover and participate in organizational campaigns. item.title: RM570448: OneDrive: Sync support for up to 1 million items on macOS
item.description: OneDrive Sync supports syncing up to 1 million items on macOS devices, helping teams manage large document libraries and shared content at scale without compromising access across devices. item.description: Keep communication more accessible throughout your meeting. item.title: RM571884: Word: Legal plugins in Copilot
item.description: Legal plugins in Copilot provide purpose-built skills to help legal professionals summarize, draft, review, and redline legal documents. Available in Word and Cowork, these plugins can use work context from Microsoft 365 and connect to supported third-party legal sources.

item.title: MC1518032: Microsoft 365 apps: Introducing Update Repair in Inventory

item.title: MC1266912: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Intelligent Summaries in Copilot Dashboard

item.title: MC1477187: Microsoft OneDrive: OneDrive sync supports up to 1 million items on macOS
item.description: OneDrive sync on macOS will increase its item limit from 300,000 to 1 million per device, starting with a Public Preview in mid-October 2026 for Insiders ring users. Devices not meeting hardware requirements will remain at the current limit, with no disruption expected.
